verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs show that audiences you build connect to audience outputs (partners chosen from the integrations directory) for activation, so the core of audience syncing to downstream tools is there. Nothing in the pack shows that the sync is continuous or that members enter and exit in near-real-time. Missing for 10: evidence of continuous or near-real-time membership updates (entry and exit), named ad-platform and engagement-tool destinations, sync latency details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time

citations.quote: Once you have created an audience, you must connect it to an audience output where you can activate it.
so more of the audiences you build can be reached and activated without increasing spend
